correctness.rationale: An alternating Pfaffian principal-minor argument proves rank twice the matching number except for a full even cycle whose rooted trees each allow an unmatched root. In that exact case every maximal Pfaffian has the common cycle binomial, which cancels for exactly one of each q-minus-one choices of the last nonzero cycle weight. Deleting one matched cycle edge gives a nonzero minor two orders smaller, so the drop is exactly two. The exceptional supports factor over rooted trees. The published odd-characteristic graphical-group rank-character identity yields the character formula. The standalone verifier exhaustively matched direct rank calculations and both combinatorial formulas for twenty graph-field instances; The symbolic proof, not finite tests, establishes the theorem.

originality.rationale: The new theorem counts all finite-field alternating-matrix rank strata for every connected simple unicyclic graph, with an exact correction factored over rooted attachments, and converts these counts to graphical-group character-degree multiplicities. Rossmann supplies the general question and character-rank reduction, Li–Yu supply a close fixed-real-weight rank classification, and published tree, cycle, and coning formulas cover restricted graph families. No inspected statement supplies the full rooted-product correction or its all-unicyclic character enumeration. This is a best-knowledge originality finding, not publication-priority certification.

value.rationale: The theorem addresses Rossmann's natural character-degree enumeration for the infinite, nontrivial full unicyclic graph family. It gives a complete exact finite-field rank histogram and a tree-factorized exceptional correction identifying the precise role of even-cycle Pfaffian cancellation. It is not merely another numerical census of one graph: all connected simple unicyclic graphs and all finite fields are handled, and explicit irreducible-character multiplicities follow over odd fields.
